Persijap Jepara vs Malut United: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Indonesian Super League match, where relegation-battling Persijap Jepara hosts one of the league leaders, Malut United. This is a clash between teams from opposite ends of the table, with the visitors being the clear favorites.

Kick-off: November 3, 2025, 08:30 UTC (11:30 MSK) Stadium: Gelora Bumi Kartini, Jepara Competition: Indonesia Super League (Liga 1)

Persijap Jepara vs Malut United: Match Preview

Persijap Jepara comes into the match in terrible form, having suffered four consecutive defeats in the league and sitting in 15th place. The team is in desperate need of points to escape the relegation zone. Malut United, on the other hand, is on the rise, occupying 3rd place in the table with a four-match winning streak. For the visitors, this is an excellent opportunity to solidify their position among the leading group.

Team Form and Analysis

Persijap Jepara

The hosts are in a deep crisis. The team is winless in their last four home matches and has lost three in a row. Persijap's main issues are their weak attack (averaging 1 goal per home game) and an unreliable defense, having conceded in each of their last five matches.

Malut United

Malut United is playing impressive football, especially in away games, where they have secured three wins in their last five fixtures. Malut is a consistent scoring threat, having found the net in their last five consecutive matches. Their confident away performance (averaging 1.65 goals per game) makes them the undisputed favorites in this clash against the underdog.

Head-to-Head Statistics

This will be one of the first encounters between the teams in the top division, which adds extra intrigue to the match. Previous meetings do not provide a clear picture due to the lack of regular high-level games.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Persijap Jepara (4-4-2): Adi Satryo - Freire, Rizky Ripora, Arya, Saputra - Sucipto, Walik, Bahari, Hidayat - Rivaldi, Rafelson.
  • Malut United (4-3-3): Priyatna - Sayuri, Aryanto, Fairussi, Adi Setiawan - Hariadi, Higgins, Kushida - Rizal, Fortes, Ricky Kambuaya.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Given Persijap's disastrous form and Malut United's winning streak, the visitors are the absolute favorites for this encounter.

  • Main Prediction: Malut United to Win. The difference in class and current form between the two teams is too significant.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Persijap struggles to score at home, and Malut United may settle for a pragmatic victory.

Semen Padang vs Arema: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of a survival battle in the Indonesian Super League, as Semen Padang hosts Arema FC at the Haji Agus Salim Stadium. This is a clash between two teams from the bottom half of the table, for whom every point is crucial.

Kick-off: November 3, 2025, 12:00 UTC (15:00 MSK) Stadium: Haji Agus Salim Stadium, Padang Competition: Indonesia Super League (Liga 1)

Semen Padang vs Arema: Match Preview

Semen Padang, currently in 15th place, enters the match in dreadful form, having lost five of their last six games. The team's only hope is their performance at their home stadium, where they have historically played well against Arema. Arema, sitting in 12th place, is also going through a tough period but holds an advantage in the overall head-to-head record. However, their terrible away form (one win in the last 10 away matches) makes this a very unpredictable encounter.

Team Form and Analysis

Semen Padang

The 'Kerbau Sirah' are having a disastrous season, but their home stadium remains their main asset. Historically, Semen Padang has been successful against Arema at home, losing only two of the last six head-to-head meetings on their own turf. However, the team's main problem is their attack: Padang has failed to score in five of their last six games.

Arema

The 'Singo Edan' have a stronger squad, but their results are not impressive. The team has won only one of their last ten away matches. Despite their overall advantage in head-to-head encounters (7 wins to 3), Arema has always found it difficult to play in Padang.

Head-to-Head Statistics

Although Arema leads the overall record (7 wins, 3 losses, 2 draws), the statistics at Semen Padang's home ground are more balanced. A key feature of this rivalry is its low-scoring nature: 7 of the last 10 head-to-head matches have ended with under 2.5 goals. In six of those ten games, at least one team failed to score.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Semen Padang (4-3-3): Fakrurrazi; Rosad, Gusmawan, Mahamadou, Sasongko; Korea, Iskandar, Ramadhan; Barbaro, Ikpefua, Nugroho.
  • Arema (4-2-3-1): Adhilaksono; Akbar, Febianto, Gurtner, Alfarizi; Evan Dimas, Hariono; Santoso, Rafaeli, Dendi; Lokosa.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

This is a classic battle of a home team against a favorite with poor away form. Considering the statistics, a high-scoring game should not be expected.

  • Main Prediction: Semen Padang to Win or Draw (1X). The home-field advantage and Arema's dreadful away form make this the most likely outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This outcome has occurred in 7 of the last 10 head-to-head meetings, and both teams are struggling in attack.

LNZ Cherkasy vs Karpaty Lviv: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Ukrainian Premier League matchday 12 fixture, as LNZ Cherkasy hosts Karpaty Lviv. This is a tactical battle between two solid teams, where LNZ's home fortress will be tested by the ambitions of the revived Karpaty.

Kick-off: November 3, 2025, 14:30 UTC (16:30 Kyiv Time) Stadium: Cherkasy-Arena, Cherkasy Competition: Ukrainian Premier League (UPL)

LNZ Cherkasy vs Karpaty Lviv: Match Preview

LNZ comes into the match as one of the best home teams in the league. Oleh Dulub's side is unbeaten in their last eight UPL matches on their home turf. Karpaty, having returned to the top flight under the guidance of Myron Markevych, aims to solidify its position in the upper half of the table, but their recent official encounters with LNZ have been extremely unsuccessful.

Team Form and Analysis

LNZ (Cherkasy)

Oleh Dulub's team is known for its pragmatic and reliable defensive play, especially at home. LNZ concedes few goals and is skilled at grinding out results. Their unbeaten home streak in the championship speaks for itself. In the 2022/23 season, when the teams last met in official matches (in the Persha Liga), LNZ thrashed Karpaty 4-1.

Karpaty (Lviv)

'The Lions' play a more attacking style of football but lack consistency, especially against well-organized opponents. Their recent official games against LNZ (a 0-0 draw and a 1-4 loss) show that the Cherkasy club is a very difficult opponent for them. Despite a win in a recent friendly match (1-0), official games are of a completely different nature.

Head-to-Head Statistics

In their last official meetings in the 2022/23 Persha Liga season, LNZ had a commanding advantage: a crushing 4-1 victory and a 0-0 draw. These results, combined with LNZ's home strength, make the hosts the favorites in this encounter.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • LNZ (5-4-1): Penkov; Stasiuk, Muravskyi, Kovalyov, Salihu, Norenkov; Naumets, Rybalka, Boyko, Pasich; Bessala.
  • Karpaty (4-3-3): Kozhukhar; Sakiv, Babohlo, Veklyak, Pidlepenets; Chekh, Ryabov, Pidhirskyi; Shah, Ihor, Chachua.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Given LNZ's impressive unbeaten home streak and their recent success in official matches against Karpaty, the hosts have every chance to secure points.

  • Main Prediction: LNZ to Win or Draw (1X). An eight-match unbeaten run at home and the head-to-head history make this outcome the most likely.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. LNZ is known for its defense, and a match against a rival is unlikely to be open and high-scoring.

Tractor Sazi vs Al Shorta: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of a key group stage match in the AFC Champions League Elite, as Iran's Tractor Sazi hosts Iraqi club Al Shorta. This is a crucial showdown where the hosts have a historical and psychological advantage.

Kick-off: November 3, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK) Stadium: Yadegar-e Emam Stadium, Tabriz Competition: AFC Champions League Elite

Tractor Sazi vs Al Shorta: Match Preview

Tractor Sazi enters the match as the clear favorite, primarily due to their home-field advantage and head-to-head record. The stadium in Tabriz is renowned for its incredible atmosphere, making it a true fortress. Al Shorta, one of Iraq's strongest clubs, will travel to Iran seeking revenge for their defeat in the last encounter, but achieving that will be extremely difficult.

Team Form and Analysis

Tractor Sazi (Iran)

The Iranian team is known for its physical strength and organized defense, especially on home turf. Tractor very rarely drops points at home in international matches. Their previous meeting with Al Shorta in 2021 ended in a confident 2-0 clean-sheet victory for the Iranians, which gives them an additional boost of confidence.

Al Shorta (Iraq)

The Iraqi club is known for its fighting spirit but often lacks consistency in away matches against top opponents. In their last game against Tractor, Al Shorta failed to create significant problems for the Iranian defense. In Tabriz, the team is likely to adopt a deep defensive strategy, hoping for a draw.

Head-to-Head Statistics

The only recent meeting between the teams took place in the 2021 AFC Champions League and ended in a convincing 2-0 victory for Tractor Sazi. This result confirms the Iranian club's status as the favorite in this matchup.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Al Shorta (4-4-2): Hassan; Abdul-Amir, Faez, Salem, Ismail; Dawood, Attwan, Abdul-Zahra, Qasim; Rostom, Fawaz.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Considering the home-field advantage, the result of the last head-to-head meeting, and the general strength of Iranian clubs in home matches, Tractor Sazi is the undisputed favorite.

Join us for the live broadcast of the AFC Champions League Elite group stage match, as Qatar's Al Duhail hosts Shabab Al Ahli from the UAE. This is a battle between two evenly matched giants from the Gulf region, whose rivalry history promises a high-scoring game.

Kick-off: November 3, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK) Stadium: Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium, Doha Competition: AFC Champions League Elite

Al Duhail vs Shabab Al Ahli: Match Preview

Despite being the home team, Al Duhail enters this match with a very poor record against Shabab Al Ahli. The Qatari club has won only one of their last six head-to-head encounters. Shabab Al Ahli, in contrast, is unbeaten against Al Duhail in regular time in the last five meetings and will be looking to extend this successful streak. The last two games between the teams ended in draws.

Team Form and Analysis

Al Duhail (Qatar)

The 'Red Knights' rely on attacking football and the individual brilliance of their leaders, such as Philippe Coutinho. The team scores a lot but also concedes regularly, including against Shabab Al Ahli. The home-field advantage will be the main asset for the Qataris as they attempt to break their winless streak against a major rival.

Shabab Al Ahli (UAE)

The Dubai-based club is known for its tactical discipline and ability to grind out results. The team has successfully countered Al Duhail's attacking style, as confirmed by their head-to-head record. Shabab Al Ahli is unbeaten in 5 of the last 6 head-to-head matches, which gives them a huge psychological advantage.

Head-to-Head Statistics

In the last six meetings, Shabab Al Ahli has the upper hand with 2 wins, 3 draws, and only 1 loss. It is important to note that in four of these six matches, both teams scored, and in three of them, there were over 2.5 goals. The last meeting in February 2023 ended in a 1-1 draw (Al Duhail advanced on penalties in the knockout stage).

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Al Duhail (4-2-3-1): Zakaria; Al-Brake, Semedo, Aymen, Al-Rawi; Madibo, Boudiaf; Coutinho, Ali, Hwang; Olunga.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Al Duhail is playing at home, their terrible record against Shabab Al Ahli and the high-scoring nature of their encounters make the outcome unpredictable but likely rich in goals.

  • Score Prediction: Draw.

Polissya vs Metalist 1925 Kharkiv: Match Preview

Polissya enters the match in excellent form, unbeaten in their last six games and having won their last two in a row. The team is in the upper part of the table and aims to continue its successful run. Metalist 1925, in contrast, is in a deep crisis, having suffered five consecutive defeats in the league. The Kharkiv side is one of the worst away teams in the league, without a single victory on the road this season.

Team Form and Analysis

Polissya (Zhytomyr)

The Zhytomyr team demonstrates a pragmatic and highly effective style of football, especially on their home turf. Polissya has one of the most reliable defenses in the league, which allows them to consistently collect points. The team is unbeaten at home in recent head-to-head encounters with Metalist 1925 and won the last game between them 2-1.

Metalist 1925 (Kharkiv)

The Kharkiv side is going through a very difficult period, having lost 9 of their 11 matches in the current UPL season. The team is facing significant problems in both attack and defense (the worst goal difference in the league). In four of their last five away matches, Metalist 1925 failed to score a single goal.

Head-to-Head Statistics

In the last four head-to-head meetings, Polissya has the advantage with two wins and two draws. Metalist 1925 has never beaten Polissya. The last game between the teams ended in a 2-1 victory for the Zhytomyr club.

Polissya is the undisputed favorite. The dreadful form of Metalist 1925, their struggles on the road, and Polissya's advantage in head-to-head encounters leave the visitors with almost no chance.

Sassuolo vs Genoa: Match Preview

Both teams lost their last matches with an identical 0-2 scoreline: Sassuolo was defeated by Empoli, while Genoa lost to Cremonese. Sassuolo, true to their attacking style, will be looking to bounce back in front of their home fans. Sassuolo

The 'Neroverdi' are facing significant defensive problems, having failed to keep a clean sheet in their last seven matches. The last six matches involving Sassuolo have seen a total of 22 goals, indicating a high-scoring trend.

Genoa

The 'Grifone' are also inconsistent, but their recent history against Sassuolo gives them a psychological edge. Alberto Gilardino's side knows how to play pragmatically and capitalize on opponents' mistakes. The main task for the visitors will be to contain the hosts' attacking momentum and exploit their weak defense.

Head-to-Head Statistics

The rivalry between these teams has been high-scoring in recent years. In five of the last six head-to-head matches, both teams have scored, and each of those five games saw over 2.5 goals. Genoa has the upper hand in recent encounters, remaining unbeaten against Sassuolo for the last three matches.

Al Gharafa vs Al Hilal: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the AFC Champions League Elite group stage match, as Qatar's Al Gharafa hosts one of the tournament's main favorites, Saudi giants Al Hilal. This is a David vs. Goliath clash in Asian football, where the hosts face a nearly impossible task.

Kick-off: November 3, 2025, 18:15 UTC (21:15 MSK) Stadium: Thani bin Jassim Stadium, Doha Competition: AFC Champions League Elite

Al Gharafa vs Al Hilal: Match Preview

Al Hilal enters the match as the undisputed favorite. The Saudi powerhouse, boasting a world-class squad, dominates both their domestic league and the international stage. Al Gharafa, a solid team from Qatar, will try to cause an upset with the support of their home crowd, but their head-to-head record and the difference in class make their chances minimal. Al Hilal is unbeaten against Al Gharafa in their last six head-to-head meetings, winning five of them.

Team Form and Analysis

Al Gharafa (Qatar)

The Qatari club relies on the experience of its foreign players, such as Yacine Brahimi. At home, Al Gharafa can cause problems for many opponents, but facing the Al Hilal machine will be extremely difficult. The main task for the hosts will be to withstand the pressure and try not to concede an early goal.

Al Hilal (Saudi Arabia)

The 'Leaders' of Asia are in phenomenal form, securing one victory after another. The team has incredible squad depth, where even the bench players are stars. The attacking line, featuring Aleksandar Mitrović and Malcom, is a threat to any defense in the world. Al Hilal has won the last three head-to-head encounters against Al Gharafa without conceding a single goal.

Head-to-Head Statistics

The statistics are entirely in Al Hilal's favor. The Saudi club is unbeaten against Al Gharafa for six matches (5 wins, 1 draw). In their last three head-to-head encounters, Al Hilal has secured three clean-sheet victories with a combined score of 6-0. The last match between the teams in 2022 ended in a 2-0 win for Al Hilal.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Al Gharafa (4-2-3-1): Al-Sheeb; Al-Muhaza, Al-Ghanem, Hassan, Al-Rawi; Hatem, Díaz; Brahimi, Sassi, Ali; Kodjia.
  • Al Hilal (4-2-3-1): Bono; Abdulhamid, Koulibaly, Al-Bulaihi, Lodi; Neves, Milinković-Savić; Malcom, Al-Faraj, Al-Dawsari; Mitrović.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Real Oviedo vs Osasuna: Match Preview

Despite their newcomer status and struggles, Real Oviedo is traditionally strong at home, which remains their only hope in this matchup.

Team Form and Analysis

Real Oviedo

The Asturians have lost three of their last five matches and have one of the weakest attacks in the league. The team relies on its defense, especially on home turf, but they will find it extremely difficult to contain an Osasuna side they regularly lose to. The hosts' chances lie in forcing a gritty, low-scoring battle and trying to avoid conceding.

Osasuna

The team from Pamplona comes into the match in good spirits after a victory in the last round. The team is known for its organized defense and its ability to edge out opponents in tight games. Given their complete dominance in head-to-head encounters, Osasuna is the clear favorite, even with the match being away from home.

Head-to-Head Statistics

The statistics are entirely in Osasuna's favor. The Pamplona side has won the last five head-to-head meetings in a row, including their last two away games in Oviedo. Matches between these teams are typically low-scoring: 8 of the last 10 games have had under 2.5 goals.
